title: Expand a conversational tool loop under a tools graph node
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, and works with the `conversational_tool_loop` recipe. Fangore binds the library conversational tool-loop recipe so a chat tools step grows nested rounds — model complete then per-tool calls — inside the tools node’s checkpoint without pre-creating empty max-turn slots. A stop contract bounds the loop. Complements `fangore_insp_stop_contract`, `fangore_node_components`, and `fangore_host_kit_event_tap`. He walks product steps (run_recipe) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^june-hf07]
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `conversational_tool_loop` (`ConversationalToolLoopTemplate`). `CliInstrumentor` verb `run_recipe` executes it via `ConversationalToolLoopRunner`, which expands `tools.subgraph` with nested `inference` and `tool_call` graph nodes per round. Soft points cover runner kinds, stop/max_iterations, message state, inference and tool dispatch. Bounds use existing `StopContract` / repeating fields.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `expanded_rounds.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
